fit_source: fresh split only, 292 lead clips (lh_fit --lead-clips-only rows), no eval139 file read
head: D2NOACC
lambda_selection: min mean OOF binary CE over the fit rows of the row set, LH's 5 folds, grid [0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1.0, 10.0, 100.0]
objective: sum CE + lambda/2 ||w||^2, intercept unpenalised (sklearn C = 1/lambda)
score: logit = ((x - mu) / sd) @ w + b,  x = [a0, v0/10, psi_dot0]  (a0 in m/s^2, psi_dot0 in rad/s, v0 in m/s)
